ops.text: Small planets around K dwarfs face the same trade-off: for the temperate sub-Neptune NGTS-47 b, a joint fit of unocculted spots, faculae and the atmosphere, with priors on the active-region coverage from contemporaneous photometry, gives an atmospheric metallicity of $\sim$234$\times$ solar, several times higher than an atmosphere-only fit to the same JWST data [⟦new.A2⟧].
